body:
Part of #1377.

Paint the base directly from the document, fill opaque redaction interiors, and repair only narrow device-pixel edge bands with small sanitized patches. Each patch includes a source-sampling halo, uses the same transform as the base, and dies after drawing its clipped tile. Work follows the mask perimeter, including during dragging/resizing. Crop coordinates and high-DPI filter reach match the sanitized export. Export rendering is unchanged.

No source-resolution raster is retained and no persistent cache is added. Steady-state memory remains one base raster R, Qt backing store, and the existing ≤64 MiB display effect tiles (each ≤1.5 MP). Blur/highlight source preparation now renders directly into their bounded display-size tiles using the same sanitized edge path; pixelation already averages sanitized samples. The rejected full-view/source-cache implementations are removed. The written Memory table stays accurate, so no docs PR is needed.

The original 16-row magenta-versus-green property test is unchanged and passing, covering83%,29%,51%,67% with redaction alone and overlapping blur/pixelate/highlight. It fails on unchanged nightly. The reused-versus-fresh canvas test is retained. Added36 rows cover crop, alpha and DPR1/1.5/2 at29%,83%,137%: covered-colour invariance remains byte-exact. Only comparison with a scaled sanitized export permits Qt filter rounding of one channel level (two with alpha); that tolerance never applies to privacy invariance.

f44 Fedora44/distro Qt6.11.2, dev presets: complete editor_contract and gui_editor_window PASS (19.50s). CI at1194b9e788908d8315a5ff04f03c7618b0c51d4a: Ubuntu24.04 and contracts passed, Ubuntu26.04 dependency installation still running; final receipt follows.

Paint measurements on f44, offscreen1200×800 at Fit;20 warmups then300 timed paintEvent calls per row. Small mask600×50 at100,100; large mask image minus100-pixel border. Drag moves across the image, resize grows toward image bounds. Live geometry updates and QWidget::render setup are outside the paintEvent timer.
